verdict.rationale: Greptile's review automation (rules, strictness, triggers) is configured via a `greptile.json` file stored in the repo root and read per source branch, which implicitly gives it git-native versioning and rollback (revert the file/commit) — but there is no explicit feature for versioning, reviewing history of, or rolling back automation configurations, dashboards, or workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated version history UI, audit trail of automation changes, one-click rollback mechanism, and any documentation framing this as a deliberate versioning/rollback feature.
